hr: A hr is a period of time equal to 1/24th of a day.
For example: "The job will take more than an hour."
Hr means the same as hour or 60 minutes.
hrolf: Hrolf is Norse chieftain who became the first duke of Normandy.
Hrolf means the same as Rollo or Rolf.
hrt: HRT is hormones are given to postmenopausal women.
HRT means the same as hormone replacement therapy or hormone-replacement therapy.
hrvatska: Hrvatska is a republic in the western Balkans in south-central Europe in the eastern Adriatic coastal area.
Hrvatska means the same as Croatia or Republic of Croatia.
hryvnia: A hryvnia is the basic unit of money in Ukraine.
